visualize_images_grid: visualize a list of PIL images as a grid using torchvision make_grid with optional resizing
visualize_images_single: visualize a single PIL image without resizing by passing size as None
visualize_frcnn_features_boxes: visualize Faster R-CNN detected object boxes and attributes on an image using a features numpy file
review_visualize_images_transforms: review the visualize_images function to understand how torchvision transforms resize and tensorize PIL images
summarize_visualize_frcnn_features: summarize the visualize_frcnn_features function that loads features and draws bounding boxes with object and attribute labels
